plan.title: Lung treated vs control DE (batch-confounded, 6v6)
plan.analytical_narrative: The design is a 6 vs 6 comparison of treated vs control human lung samples where batch B2 holds all treated samples and batch B1 holds all controls — batch is perfectly confounded with condition. This is a hard limitation: no statistical method (ComBat-seq, SVA, a batch term in the model, removeBatchEffect) can separate a condition effect from a batch effect when they are perfectly collinear, because the model matrix would not be full rank and any 'correction' would remove the condition signal along with the batch signal. Per the grounded rule R-0005, the plan does NOT fit a batch term or attempt batch correction. Instead: (1) QC step visualizes whether treated/control samples separate on PCA/sample-distance and explicitly flags this as INDISTINGUISHABLE from a pure batch effect; (2) the DE step runs DESeq2 ~condition (the only estimable model) and every output is labeled confounded; (3) enrichment on the resulting ranked list is run for hypothesis generation only, with the same caveat; (4) the report states plainly, in its lead sentence, that no gene called 'differential' here can be attributed to treatment rather than to processing batch, and that a design with batches spanning both conditions is required before these results can support any causal or clinical claim.
